criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a real render on a dark field. 09 about 8 passes (slab seated, inlays the focal). 02 about 7.5 a true relief, worn rows in the grey middle. 06 about 7, the best composition, the kit figure mannequin-smooth. 01 about 7, the lamps lead; windshield flat black, a hard ground edge left of the car. 07 about 6.5, a bold diagonal now; the bar tops one broad mid-tone band, a stair-stepped shadow edge, a colour fringe bottom right. 05 about 6.5, the kerb wedge and gutter aliasing stand, bars flat quads. 08 about 6.5, a flat dim rectangle with little pool falloff. 04 about 6, a uniform pattern at 432, the amber row about 10 px on the claim line, prism faces navy-black. 03 about 5.5, a strip about 8 percent of the height between a dead sky and a dead foreground.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck: near-black asphalt, bead-white paint, one terracotta accent on 6, 8 and 9, casts to the right, one type band, no strobe; MOTIF_EVOLUTION real; CAMERA_MOVE 6 to 7. 01's warm haze and 03's brown band sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; round 1's leads closed (both counties named, the ballot sentence whole, c46 dropped). Remaining looseness: frame 4's dek says brass where the markers render amber; frame 2's '2023, 70 IN ALL' sits over the 28 fresh stripes only; the 72 hours and 'no second vote' rest on the Tribune, attributed.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Place, body, proposition, date, resolution and its condition all named; frames 6 to 8 make the stake concrete. The action step covers only Harris County's hours; the caption's closing question answered nowhere.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover sets place and vote, frame 2 pays at once, frame 3 a correction frame, frame 4 a detour, the turn 5 to 7 lands, 8 to 9 drive to a usable close.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific, local, unhyped; strong lines. 'Drawn to illustrate.' a tic on eight deks; frame 5's dek a run of fragments.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The technique fresh, the palette and accent register familiar, the subject close to no. 39 and its road-at-night cover.

one_sentence_fix: Re-camera frames 3 and 4 low and close so the bars and the officer row fill the lower half, and drop frame 5's kerb to the asphalt's value.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A strip about 8 percent of the frame between a dead sky and a dead foreground; a flat curb band; arbitrary pebbles.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Eye about 0.6 m, about 1.8 m off the pan at fov 28, pan and bars corner to corner across the lower half; remove the pebbles; curb to the asphalt's value.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A tan kerb wedge upper left, gutter-lip aliasing, bars flat quads.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Kerb and gutter albedo to the asphalt's value; raise the shadow map resolution so each bar casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A uniform tan pattern at 432; the amber markers about 10 px on the claim line; prism faces navy-black.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Eye about 0.6 m at fov 28 with the amber row about 25 percent up from the bottom; warm the prism faces.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bar tops one broad mid-tone band; a stair-stepped near shadow; a colour fringe bottom right.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken the top albedo so only the chamfers catch the key; raise shadow map size; crop the fringe.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat dim rectangle with hard edges and little pool falloff; reads as a grille.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the pool on the start bar and row 1, near black by row 3; a lit kerb edge at the top.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat black windshield, primitive body, a hard ground edge left of the car.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An environment reflection in the glass; extend the ground under the fog.
